title: Zia and the Runaway Space Station
subtitle: A Space Adventure
blurb: When the adults leave on a routine supply run, Halcyon Station's computer goes haywire and starts flying 400 homes straight at a field of space rock. The only ones aboard are nine kids, one concussed counselor and a very dramatic robot. Zia Okonkwo can fix anything, as long as nobody helps her. She has 36 hours to learn that the hardest repair is asking.
